authority.token_source: Use only the task-issued platform bearer; never print or persist it.
authority.owner_continuation: This user-authorized direct Codex run uses the public owner API.

rules: The index contract is immutable after creation.
A source revision, ACL and URL travel together.
A repeated event_id is replayed; the same event_id with another payload is rejected.
An older source revision cannot overwrite a newer revision.
Read the current revision before every mutation.
BookStack API authentication must use a platform Secret reference.
Use the HTTP block only for customer-authorized BookStack GET page calls.
Project field mapping belongs in the workflow and must not enter platform source.
Run business tests and inspect actual artifacts before publication.
